description.value: Happy Singh Street Eats is an Indian street food restaurant in Delta, BC, serving 130+ authentic dishes made fresh to order alongside an extensive menu of shakes, creams, and desserts. Opened in 2020 as the brand's first location on Scott Road, it is operated by Tandoori Flame Restaurants and has since expanded to Brampton, Ontario. Cyclists can order at self-serve kiosks or online, with both dine-in and takeout available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page confirms the Surrey-Delta location phone as 778.578.6666, matching the OSM tag, and the online ordering page has a dedicated Surrey-Delta order link confirming the location is active. However, OSM lists the address as 'Scott Road' while the website contact page lists '120 St' for the same location — these are the same road in Delta/Surrey but the naming differs, and the website adds postal code V4C 6R6. No content on the website mentions bike parking, water refill, or washroom availability.
concerns: OSM address uses 'Scott Road' while website contact page lists '120 St' for the Surrey-Delta location — these are the same road but the street name representation differs; website also provides postal code V4C 6R6 absent from OSM.

Website URL (https://happysingh.com/) was discovered rather than listed in OSM tags and covers two distinct locations (Surrey-Delta and Brampton); record is unambiguously the Surrey-Delta location based on address and phone match.
No bike-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed open food and drink business with takeout available, making it a plausible cycling stop on a major Delta corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the available website evidence.
